title: teesdalia
intro: Teesdalia, commonly known as "candytuft", is a flowering plant that belongs to the Brassicaceae family. It is rich in health benefits, including its ability to support immune function, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties, making it a potential remedy for various health conditions. The therapeutic actions of Teesdalia include its potential to alleviate symptoms of anxiety and depression, promote wound healing, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Teesdalia include glucosinolates, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
